<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Анна Нестеровна: мышление и речь</title>
<meta name="description" content="Бесплатный урок на харизму и голос. Анна Нестеровна — риторика, речь, коучинг. Контакты и запись.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400;1,500&family=Golos+Text:wght@400;500;600&family=Great+Vibes&family=Oranienbaum&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  @font-face {
    font-family: 'Unifix SP';
    src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');
    font-display: swap;
    unicode-range: U+0041-005A, U+0061-007A, U+0400-045F;
  }

  :root {
    --bg: #FAF7F4;
    --paper: #FFFFFF;
    --cream: #F6EFE6;
    --mist: #EEEAE7;
    --wine: #5B0F1D;
    --wine-deep: #3A0A12;
    --wine-bright: #8C1C2F;
    --rose: #EBD6D6;
    --tape: #D9C7AC;
    --ink: #2A1114;
    --muted: #806A6C;
    --line: #E2D6D3;
    --gold: #F7E3B4;
    --display: "Cormorant", "Times New Roman", Georgia, serif;
    --script: "Great Vibes", "Segoe Script", cursive;
    --sans: "Golos Text", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif;
    --brand: "Unifix SP", "Golos Text", Arial, sans-serif;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    margin: 0; overflow-x: clip; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }
  a { color: inherit; }
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--wine-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

  .wrap { width: 100%; max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; padding-left: 20px; padding-right: 20px; }
  .script { font-family: var(--script); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0; }

  /* Шапка */
  .top {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px;
    flex-wrap: wrap; padding-top: 30px; padding-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .site-name {
    margin: 0; font-family: var(--brand); font-weight: 400;
    font-size: clamp(23px, 3.5vw, 40px); line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: 0;
    color: var(--wine-deep); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; column-gap: .5em;
  }
  .site-name span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .36em; white-space: nowrap; }
  .site-name span + span { color: var(--wine-bright); }
  .site-name .star { width: .6em; height: .6em; fill: currentColor; }

  /* Кнопка «Мой сайт» в шапке — красная, справа */
  .btn-site {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--wine-bright); border: 1.5px solid var(--wine-bright); color: #fff;
    text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: background-color .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s;
  }
  .btn-site svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex: none; transition: transform .25s; }
  .btn-site:hover { background: var(--wine); border-color: var(--wine); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-site:hover svg { transform: rotate(45deg); }

  /* Секции */
  .section { padding-bottom: 96px; }
  .section-first { padding-top: 44px; }
  h2 {
    margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; color: var(--wine-deep);
    font-size: clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 58px); line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  }
  h2 .script { color: var(--wine-bright); font-size: 1.15em; line-height: 1; padding: 0 .06em; }

  /* Лист блокнота */
  .sheet {
    position: relative; margin-top: 52px; padding: 60px 34px 38px;
    background: var(--paper); border-radius: 3px 3px 16px 16px;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--line), 0 26px 50px -34px rgba(58,10,18,.5);
  }
  .rings { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -20px; height: 54px; pointer-events: none; }
  .rings::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -10px; right: -10px; top: 12px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(#8f8279, #5c5049); }
  .rings i {
    position: absolute; top: 0; width: 15px; height: 44px; margin-left: -7px;
    border: 3px solid #8A7D75; border-left-color: #C9BEB6; border-radius: 9px;
  }
  .rings i::after {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 31px; width: 11px; height: 11px; margin-left: -5.5px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 3px rgba(58,10,18,.4); z-index: -1;
  }
  .rings i:nth-child(1) { left: 10%; } .rings i:nth-child(2) { left: 50%; } .rings i:nth-child(3) { left: 90%; }

  /* Сетка ссылок */
  .links { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
  .link {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px;
    padding: 18px 20px 18px 24px; border-radius: 12px; text-decoration: none;
    background: var(--bg); border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    transition: background-color .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s;
  }
  .link b { display: block; font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; }
  .link small { display: block; font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--muted); transition: color .2s; }
  .link svg {
    flex: none; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--wine); color: var(--wine);
    transition: background-color .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s, transform .25s;
  }
  .link:hover { background: var(--wine); border-color: var(--wine); color: #fff; }
  .link:hover small { color: var(--rose); }
  .link:hover svg { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; color: var(--wine); transform: rotate(45deg); }

  /* Урок: площадки */
  .free { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 22px; margin-top: 48px; }
  .free a {
    position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 30px;
    min-height: 230px; padding: 38px 28px 26px; text-decoration: none;
    background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink);
    transition: transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--line), 0 24px 44px -30px rgba(58,10,18,.45);
  }
  .free a:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-1.2deg); }
  .free a:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(.4deg); }
  .free a:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(1.2deg); }
  .free a:hover { transform: rotate(0) translateY(-4px); }
  .free .tape {
    position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -19px; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-4deg);
    width: max-content; padding: 0 26px; height: 36px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: var(--tape); opacity: .96;
    font-family: var(--script); font-size: 24px; color: var(--wine);
  }
  .free h3 {
    margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: 32px;
    line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--wine-deep);
  }
  .free p { margin: 0; font-size: 15.5px; color: #5A4346; }
  .free .go {
    align-self: flex-start; padding: 8px 20px; border: 1.5px solid var(--wine); border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--wine); transition: background-color .2s, color .2s;
  }
  .free a:hover .go { background: var(--wine); color: #fff; }

  /* Тёмный низ: контакты */
  .dark { background: var(--wine-deep); color: #fff; padding: 96px 0 40px; }
  .dark h2 { color: var(--cream); }
  .dark h2 .script { color: var(--rose); }
  .dark .sheet {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
    box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(235,214,214,.16), 0 26px 50px -34px rgba(0,0,0,.7);
  }
  .dark .rings::before { background: linear-gradient(#b9a79c, #7d6b60); }
  .dark .rings i { border-color: #A9958B; border-left-color: #D8C8BE; }
  .dark .rings i::after { background: var(--wine-deep); }
  .dark .link { background: rgba(250,247,244,.06); border-color: rgba(235,214,214,.22); color: var(--cream); }
  .dark .link small { color: #C9A9AD; }
  .dark .link svg { border-color: var(--rose); color: var(--rose); }
  .dark .link:hover { background: var(--cream); border-color: var(--cream); color: var(--wine-deep); }
  .dark .link:hover small { color: var(--wine); }
  .dark .link:hover svg { background: var(--wine-deep); border-color: var(--wine-deep); color: var(--cream); }

  /* Кнопка «Мой сайт» в контактах */
  .link-site {
    grid-column: 1 / -1; padding: 26px 30px 26px 34px; border-radius: 14px;
    background: var(--wine-bright); border-color: var(--wine-bright); color: #fff;
  }
  .link-site b { font-family: var(--display); font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(26px, 3.2vw, 38px); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  .link-site b .script { font-size: 1.25em; color: var(--rose); margin-right: .12em; }
  .link-site small { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 16px; color: var(--rose); max-width: 36em; }
  .link-site svg { width: 52px; height: 52px; padding: 16px; background: #fff; border-color: #fff; color: var(--wine-bright); }
  .link-site:hover { background: var(--cream); border-color: var(--cream); color: var(--wine-deep); }
  .link-site:hover small { color: var(--wine); }
  .link-site:hover svg { background: var(--wine-deep); border-color: var(--wine-deep); color: var(--cream); }

  .end { text-align: center; padding-top: 72px; padding-bottom: 48px; }
  .end p { margin: 16px auto 28px; max-width: 30em; font-size: 18.5px; color: var(--rose); }
  .end-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; }
  .oval {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 15px 38px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--cream); border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--cream);
    transition: background-color .2s, color .2s;
  }
  .oval:hover, .oval-fill { background: var(--cream); color: var(--wine-deep); }
  .oval-fill:hover { background: #fff; }

  footer { font-size: 14.5px; color: #C9A9AD; margin-top: 40px; }
  footer > div {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: flex-start; gap: 8px 32px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(235,214,214,.25); padding-top: 22px;
  }
  footer a { color: var(--gold); text-underline-offset: 3px; }
  footer a:hover { color: #fff; }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .free { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .links { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .section { padding-bottom: 72px; }
    .dark { padding-top: 72px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .site-name { font-size: 7vw; flex-direction: column; }
    .btn-site { padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 12px; }
    .sheet { padding: 54px 16px 24px; }
    .free h3 { font-size: 28px; }
    .link-site { padding: 24px 20px 24px 22px; }
    .link-site svg { width: 46px; height: 46px; padding: 13px; }
    .end-actions .oval { width: 100%; }
    footer > div { flex-direction: column; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true">

    <path d="M50.0 0.0 L54.5 42.2 L87.2 28.5 L59.0 50.0 L87.2 71.5 L54.5 57.8 L50.0 100.0 L45.5 57.8 L12.8 71.5 L41.0 50.0 L12.8 28.5 L45.5 42.2Z"/>
  </symbol>
</svg>

<header class="wrap top">

  <a class="btn-site" href="https://anesterovna.ru" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

    <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 13 13 3M5 3h8v8"/></svg>
  </a>
</header>

<main id="top">

  <!-- БЕСПЛАТНЫЙ УРОК -->
  <section class="wrap section section-first" id="lesson">
    <h2>Урок на <span class="script">харизму</span></h2>
    <p class="section-lead">
      «HARIZMA: харизма и голос» — бесплатный урок о том, как звучать уверенно

    </p>

    <div class="free">
      <a href="https://youtu.be/-3JKARVYCg4?is=4W936W3goZwzcB1e" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

        <div>
          <h3>YouTube</h3>
          <p>Урок «HARIZMA: харизма и голос» — смотреть на YouTube.</p>

      <a href="https://rutube.ru/video/b67990e2600799982882f78cee9b091c/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

        <span class="go">смотреть на RuTube</span>
      </a>

      <a href="https://vk.ru/anfocuses" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

      </a>
    </div>
  </section>

</main>

<!-- КОНТАКТЫ -->
<div class="dark" id="contacts">
  <section class="wrap">

    <div class="sheet">
      <div class="rings" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
      <div class="links">

        <a class="link link-site" href="https://anesterovna.ru" target="_blank" rel="noopener">

          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 13 13 3M5 3h8v8"/></svg>

      </div>

    <div class="end">
      <p>Хотите уверенно говорить и выступать? Начните с бесплатного урока или сразу запишитесь на встречу.</p>
      <div class="end-actions">
        <a class="oval oval-fill" href="#lesson">Смотреть урок</a>

    <footer>

        <span>© 2026 Семенова Анна Нестеровна, самозанятая</span>

  </section>
